_comment: Deploy-artifact size budgets (bytes), enforced by check_deploy_artifact.mts. Re-measured 2026-08-01 (provenance wave 1 integration, incl. cross-browser durability lane): total 11,440,542; .js 927,917; .wasm 8,357,657. Runtime WASM 6,333,180: (a) the source-result influence witness v2 (per-row precision classes, source_field/target_output_column columns, column-granular declared-scope routing) and the per-query field-level read/write declarations in the workflow contract (+114,990 over the 2026-07-28 baseline); (b) `--merge-similar-functions` removed from the release wasm-opt flags in rust/chronicle_preprocessing_runtime_wasm/Cargo.toml (+177,834 uncompressed, gzip unchanged) because merging Salsa 0.28's per-jar `fn() -> TypeId` thunks corrupted jar identity — the second salsa::Storage in one WASM instance registered an incomplete jar map and aborted WebKit runs with `ingredient JarImpl<UsageSupportInput> was not registered`; the Cargo.toml comment carries the evidence. Runtime WASM cap raised 6,100,000 to 6,400,000; .wasm total 8,200,000 to 8,430,000; assets total 11,250,000 to 11,500,000. Worker chunk 134,190 (cap 127,000 to 136,000): the streaming workspace-archive builder/import verification, the runOnSlot/abortInFlight cancel fix, and probeWorkspaceCapability's verified OPFS write/read-back round trip in the writing worker. .js total 927,917 (cap 910,000 to 935,000): the generated runtime-boundary validator artifact plus the worker code above. Prior raise rationales retained in git history. Budgets retain limited headroom; raising one requires a named cause and a new measurement.
